data.body:
Second victim of this bug's O(pins x4) collect(): plan-review SIGNING, not just `rebar show`.

generation.sign_manifest's freshness fence wraps `collect()` (-> collect_plan_relation_snapshot -> live_material_children -> the same per-pin full-store reduction this ticket fixes). Reproduced read-only on epic 3d7a-7795-efde-4df7: collect() median 10.2s / max 12.9s. That ~10s window is exactly the sign fence's required-quiescence interval (bug a83f-6348-a08c-401d, mechanism A), so under concurrent writes 3/12 sign attempts exhaust the retry budget and NO attestation persists -> the ticket cannot be claimed/closed.

Implication: this ticket's fix (single shared snapshot, ~1s) shortens the sign-fence window ~10x, largely resolving the a83f head-move exhaustion as a side effect. Worth flagging as an additional beneficiary and a severity bump: 3d57 does not only slow reads -- via the shared collect() it also blocks the plan-review claim/close gate under sustained multi-session load. See my comment on a83f for the reproduction data.
